The per item response labels and values in each note match the form exactly, including the 'In the past 7 days' stem on Global10r and Global08r and the 0 to 10 pain scale with 'No pain' and 'Worst pain imaginable'. The remainder of the licence field (free English use, fees since 2024 for translations and vendors) is a summary; the Steps to License page confirms that translation and platform licensing (Epic, API) carry fees but does not state the free use terms or a 2024 date, so that part is unconfirmed.
